decisions.finding: Under initial Vav of ותִּשְׂרֹף, high-resolution preemptive capture demonstrates a crisp, solid horizontal Patah bar spanning 30 pixels wide and 17 pixels tall stamped directly beneath the Vav foot. Clean white paper separates the mark from surrounding ink; matches positive control Patah from הַלֶּהָבָה on the same line. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).

Under initial Vav of ותֹּאכְלֵם, high-resolution preemptive capture demonstrates a distinct horizontal Patah bar 22 pixels wide directly below the Vav stem, followed by clean white paper below. Distinct from competing two-dot Sheva under Shin/Kaf. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).
